wikipediaArticleRead.support: L144 states that the Tribe of Levi is one of Israel’s tribes traditionally descended from Levi. L147 describes the tribe’s duties. 1 Kings 12:31 specifically says “sons of Levi,” a collective reference.

sourceTextExcerpts.text: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
